item.title: Milestone Payment Billing Software for Solar Installers
item.description: Search “milestone payment billing software for solar installers” and every result is the same: a vendor feature page or a listicle showing screenshots of an invoicing dashboard. Not one of them explains how a milestone structure actually works before pitching you a subscription. That is backwards. The software is the easy part. The hard part is getting the payment stages, the deposit limits and the contract wording right, because that is what decides whether you get paid on time or spend three months chasing a final invoice.
